frictions.description: VAL-DB-013: With small test data (1 row), PostgreSQL optimizer chooses Seq Scan over Index Scan even though index exists. This is correct optimizer behavior for small tables, not a bug.
frictions.resolution: Verified index exists via pg_indexes query. Forced Index Scan with SET enable_seqscan=off to confirm index is usable and properly configured.

frictions.description: Test UUIDs must use standard UUID format (8-4-4-4-12 hex digits) not 'test-' prefix format. Initial test used 'test-00000000-...' which failed.
frictions.resolution: Used proper UUID format '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' for test data inserts.
